title: Qiqi the baby zombie
description: Changes baby zombie to Qiqi from Genshin Impact. Requires OptiFine.
body:
Changes **baby zombie** to **Qiqi** from Genshin Impact.
![Qiqi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4efa34b8a9e7bf240396339b1e713f36932293d.png)
## **Attention!**
This texturepack requires mod **OptiFine**. It works without it, but the texture will change for both a baby zombie and an adult zombie.
### OptiFine _On_
![OF on](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/663ee9af803df9f376fabdfbdaeb20a4f1aec1ab.png)
### OptiFine _Off_
![OF off](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d814d6967cdacb40d58e1d18c2f1573a321d8f1.png)
Even Hu Tao was afraid of this little devil
![Hu Tao](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50eacb15606e1efcaec7528b69a3143bd5dfad32_0.webp)
